reference_model.name: mistral-small:24b
reference_model.zero_hard_note: 638 of 653 successes are integrity-clean. The 15 that are not are validation-DISABLED releases (citation validation bypassed by design). Validation-ENABLED subset: 553/560 success, all 553 zero-hard. Main condition phase_a_main: 99/100.

current_local_battery.note: Outcomes are computed from 941 writer-stage attempts: 887 success, 20 checker-flagged, and 34 writer failures. The accepted paper artifacts are deposited under results/local_battery_vlm_2_1/exhibits/. The prior v17 bundle remains under results/corrected/ for historical comparison.

citation_normalization.note: Deterministic final-assembly document-ID normalizer applied to 907 produced vlm.2.0 reviews. It changes 49 review files; per_run.csv records 41 checker-failed to success transitions.

current_local_battery.denominator_note: Per-model counts here are WRITER-STAGE: only attempts that produced a writer ledger entered the 941-item battery. Attempts that refused or failed before the writer are preserved separately as the 1,184 pre-writer terminals. End-to-end model rates must recombine the two (941 writer replays + 1,184 pre-writer + 300 baselines = 2,425 classified).
